title: Production Planning and Control
description:
Studied the fundamentals of production systems, operations management, and production planning and control, with a focus on coordinating resources, improving operational efficiency, and meeting production requirements.

Key Topics Covered:

Production Systems: Types of production systems, manufacturing processes, and production planning and control activities.

Operations Management: Resource coordination, production decisions, and value-added versus non-value-added activities.

Demand Forecasting: Qualitative and quantitative forecasting methods, time-series analysis, moving averages, exponential smoothing, regression analysis, and forecast error evaluation.

Inventory Management: Inventory classification, ABC analysis, Economic Order Quantity (EOQ), Economic Production Quantity (EPQ), and quantity discount models.

Inventory Control: Reorder Point (ROP), Safety Stock, probabilistic demand models, and periodic and continuous inventory review systems.

Knowledge Gained:

Developed an understanding of how demand forecasting, inventory management, and production planning work together to support manufacturing operations, balance inventory costs, improve resource utilization, and maintain product availability.
